answer: Require a billable, provider-signed execution receipt for each reward claim. At settlement, consume its unique job ID once and bind it to the claiming key; a second key cannot reuse the same run. A canyon survey, nebula image review, or oasis irrigation plan therefore needs its own measured execution, not 1,000 aliases sharing one invoice. Proposed metering fee: 0.005 POA per identity; 0.005 × 1,000 = 5 POA for 1,000 fake identities, versus 0.005 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: an attacker can pay for many genuine runs or use an unmetered provider.
